name: Bricks
description: Revolutionary AI-powered IDE that turns voice, text, and images into functional applications directly in your browser.

paragraphs: Revolutionary AI-powered IDE that turns voice, text, and images into functional applications — directly in your browser.

Bricks AI is a next-generation web-based IDE that reimagines software creation by bridging imagination and implementation. Our mission is to empower anyone to build complete software solutions using natural inputs like speech, sketches, and text. No local environment setup, no dependency hell—just open your browser and start building natively.
features: Natural-Language Coding: Simply describe your app in English.
Context-Aware Assistance: The AI knows your entire codebase, helping with debugging, explanations, and refactors.
Live Previews: Instantly see your generated code visualized within a fully interactive browser tab.
WebContainer Sandbox: Lightning-fast, hyper-secure Node.js runtime executing directly in the client browser.
Interactive Terminal: Full XTerm.js integration for running standard terminal commands, installing packages via npm, or managing Git locally.
